lines.text: Vance's garden was the warmest room in Aldcrown. White roses, under a roof of glass. He poured the tea himself.
Sugar? How many?
None. It's something of a habit.
He laughed. It was a nice laugh. That was the worst thing about him. Everything about him was nice. He never once mentioned his Hounds. Neither did I.
Let's not pretend, Lucan. I know what you are. And I think, by now, you know it too. A hollow-born. The first in a very long time.
Three hundred years ago, one of your kind froze the whole north. The Order exists so that never happens again. I'm not your enemy. I'm the man who keeps the kingdom warm.
The little Measurer at the tithe-house had said the same words. Nobody in that village had been warm.
Then he opened a small box, and turned it toward me.
A ring. Milky pale glass, set in gold. I had seen one like it once, on Penhallow's hand, flickering in the steam.

Wear this at the Remeasuring, and the Stone will show five rings. A true lord. A seat at court. A house on Crown Hill. And Greyhollow left in peace. Your people, your barley, your little Compact. Untouched.
And in return?
You live here, in Aldcrown, where I can see you. For the rest of your life.
Your people will stop growing, of course. That's rather the point. But they'll be alive, and fed, and nobody will ever march north. Isn't that what you want for them?
It was. That was the trap. He wasn't offering me a cage. He was offering them a future, with me as the price.
And if I say no?
Then the Stone decides. In front of everyone.
I looked at the ring for a long time. I thought of Bram, building his wall. Of Tilda, laughing on Ash's back.
I need time.
Of course. Take until the Tourney. I'm a very patient man, Lucan. And the Stone is even more patient than I am.
He closed the box, and kept it. He knew I'd think about it anyway.
Ilse was waiting outside the gate in her square spectacles, pretending to sell lavender. She had sold four bunches. She was furious about it.
Well?
He offered me five rings. I asked for time. Ilse, I need to know what that Stone really does. Can you get into the Order's College?
Lucan. I've been working in it since Tuesday. And there's something in the cellars they won't let anyone see.
The Lord Who Measured Zero. Chapter seventy-three, coming soon.
